proposed_comments.title: Keep fallback operational values raw
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep fallback operational values raw

**Severity:** `high`

The grouped title is correct for display, but the fallback item still rewrites both operational commands from `result.Title`. That means selecting a fallback result such as `500,000` would copy, paste, and save `500,000` instead of the raw calculator value `500000`, which breaks the display-only promise of the feature and pollutes follow-up calculations/history. Please pass the raw operational value through `FallbackCalculatorItem` (for example `result.TextToSuggest`) and keep regression coverage on the actual fallback-item path rather than only `CreateResultForFallback`.
